en.multiphysics.model_breeze_hint: The air around the model: the breeze comes in at −X and leaves at +X, the sides along it slip, and the top is open. 0 is still air. Without a floor the bottom is open too.
en.multiphysics.model_climate_hint: A year in four seasons, each a night, morning, afternoon and evening, the warmest at 15:00. Breeze and dust follow the day: calm and clean at night, windy and dusty in the afternoon. Edit the seasons, then Set the year.
en.multiphysics.model_climate_missing: {condition} has not run yet: the year leaves it out
en.multiphysics.model_climate_studies_hint: Each condition gets a study of its own with the air at its temperature, its breeze and its dust. Run them all (Batch run), then Year summary.
en.multiphysics.model_climate_totals: {in} g of dust comes in a year and {deposited} g settles, over {hours} hours run
en.multiphysics.model_dust_from_air: Counted from the air coming in at the domain's sides
en.multiphysics.model_dust_from_box: Counted where air crosses into the box from {low} to {high} mm
en.multiphysics.model_dust_hint: The dust is followed through the settled flow to where it lands: drag, gravity, the push from warm to cold and Brownian motion (companion 0.19.0).
en.multiphysics.model_dust_inside: Count what enters the picked body
en.multiphysics.model_environment_hint: The air around the model, the dust in it, and the year it works through.
en.multiphysics.model_thin_walls_hint: Walls thinner than a cell stay walls: every grid face a body's surface crosses is closed, so an enclosure keeps only its real openings. Air the walls seal off is filled.
